interpretation: Indicates whether the URL uses HTTPS.
caution: Dataset-dependent signal; HTTPS should not be interpreted as proof of safety or danger.

interpretation: Measures character randomness and possible obfuscation.
caution: High entropy can also appear in legitimate generated URLs.

interpretation: Measures how much of the URL is numeric.
caution: Numeric-heavy URLs can be suspicious but are not always malicious.

interpretation: Counts numeric characters in the URL.
caution: Useful for generated-looking URLs, but some benign URLs contain IDs.

interpretation: Measures total URL length.
caution: Long URLs may indicate tracking or obfuscation but are not inherently phishing.

interpretation: Measures length of the URL path.
caution: Long paths can appear in both phishing and legitimate web applications.

interpretation: Measures the proportion of non-alphanumeric characters.
caution: Special characters can indicate obfuscation but also normal query/path syntax.

interpretation: Counts alphabetic characters in the URL.
caution: Acts as a general lexical composition signal.

interpretation: Counts hyphens in the URL.
caution: Hyphens can be used in deceptive domains but are common in benign domains too.

interpretation: Measures domain and subdomain length.
caution: Long hostnames can indicate suspicious subdomain structures.

interpretation: Counts dot characters in the URL.
caution: Many dots may indicate deep subdomain nesting.

interpretation: Counts path segments.
caution: Deep paths may reflect complex routing or phishing landing pages.

interpretation: Counts subdomain levels before the registered domain.
caution: Useful for detecting deceptive nested subdomains.

interpretation: Counts slash characters.
caution: Correlates with URL structure and path depth.

interpretation: Counts non-alphanumeric characters.
caution: Captures punctuation-heavy or encoded-looking URLs.

interpretation: Measures numeric density in the hostname.
caution: May indicate generated domains, but some benign services use digits.

interpretation: Counts security or account-related words.
caution: Useful supporting signal, but easy for attackers to avoid.

interpretation: Measures query string length.
caution: Long queries may reflect tracking, forms, or obfuscation.

interpretation: Counts equals signs in query parameters.
caution: Mostly reflects query string structure.

interpretation: Counts at symbols.
caution: Can indicate URL obfuscation, though rare in this dataset.

interpretation: Counts query parameters.
caution: Captures URL parameter complexity.

interpretation: Indicates whether a query string is present.
caution: Low-level structure signal.

interpretation: Counts underscores.
caution: Minor lexical composition signal.

interpretation: Counts ampersands in query strings.
caution: Mostly reflects multiple query parameters.

interpretation: Counts question marks.
caution: Mostly indicates query string presence.

interpretation: Indicates whether a URL fragment is present.
caution: Low-importance structure signal in this dataset.

interpretation: Indicates whether the hostname is an IP address.
caution: Important cybersecurity signal, but rare in this dataset.

interpretation: Indicates whether a custom port is present.
caution: Potentially suspicious but rare in this dataset.
